sheets.name: Basic Fantasy RPG
sheets.description: A character sheet for Basic Fantasy RPG: four classes, ascending armour class, and the five saving throws. Uses the default sectioned layout — the game is small enough not to need a custom one.
sheets.author: hunter-read
sheets.attribution: Basic Fantasy Role-Playing Game is © Chris Gonnerman, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0. See basicfantasy.org.

sheets.name: Cairn
sheets.description: A character sheet for Cairn, Yochai Gal's rules-light dark-fantasy adventure game. Three ability scores, no classes, no levels — the whole sheet fits on a card.
sheets.author: hunter-read
sheets.attribution: Cairn is © Yochai Gal, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0. See cairnrpg.com.

sheets.name: Call of Cthulhu 7th Edition
sheets.description: An investigator sheet for Call of Cthulhu 7th Edition: eight characteristics and percentile skills with their half and fifth values, hit points, magic points, Sanity and Luck, damage bonus, Build and Move, and the occupation and personal-interest points a new investigator spends.

sheets.name: Cosmere RPG
sheets.description: A character sheet for Brandon Sanderson's Cosmere Roleplaying Game, after the Mistborn campaign setting sheet: six attributes and the three defenses they make, health, focus and Investiture, the eighteen skills with their ranks and modifiers, lifting capacity, movement, recovery die and senses range, and purpose, obstacle and goals.
sheets.author: hunter-read
sheets.attribution: This is unofficial fan content, created and shared for non-commercial use. It has not been reviewed by Dragonsteel Entertainment, LLC or Brotherwise Games, LLC.

sheets.name: D&D 5th Edition (2024)
sheets.description: A character sheet for the 2024 revision of D&D 5th Edition, with the SRD 5.2 catalogue of classes and their features, species, backgrounds, feats, spells, equipment and magic items.
sheets.author: hunter-read

sheets.name: Draw Steel
sheets.description: A hero sheet for MCDM's Draw Steel: characteristics, stamina and recoveries, the heroic resource, and abilities with their power-roll tiers. Picking an ancestry, culture, career, class or kit fills in what it gives; every value can still be set by hand.
sheets.author: hunter-read
sheets.attribution: Grimoire is an independent product published under the DRAW STEEL Creator License and is not affiliated with MCDM Productions, LLC. DRAW STEEL © 2026 MCDM Productions, LLC.

sheets.name: Dungeon Crawler Carl
sheets.description: An unofficial crawler sheet for the Dungeon Crawler Carl Roleplaying Game: five stats enhanced and unenhanced, health in tenths, evade and damage resistance totals, mana, buffs and attacks, the hotlist and gear slots, skills, inventory, pet and mount, and sponsors. Structure only - bring the rules from your book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Renegade Game Studios or Matt Dinniman.
sheets.author: hunter-read

sheets.name: Pathfinder 1st Edition
sheets.description: A character sheet for the first edition of the Pathfinder Roleplaying Game, after the 2009 character sheet: abilities with temporary adjustments, AC with touch and flat-footed, saves, initiative, base attack, CMB and CMD with size, every skill with class-skill, armor check penalty and size applied, carrying capacity and loads, and spell save DCs and bonus spells.

sheets.name: Pathfinder 2e
sheets.description: A character sheet for Pathfinder 2e: proficiency ranks that add your level once trained, three saves, bulk-based encumbrance, and rank-based spellcasting. Picking an ancestry, background or class fills in what it gives; every value can still be set by hand.
sheets.author: hunter-read
sheets.attribution: This product is based on the Pathfinder Second Edition rules, published by Paizo Inc. under the ORC License. Pathfinder is a trademark of Paizo Inc. See https://paizo.com/orclicense.

sheets.name: Traveller (Mongoose 2nd Edition)

Brannen's character spreadsheet: characteristics with their dice modifiers and UPP, every skill and speciality with its check DM against each characteristic, psionics, weapons with their attack DM, armour, encumbrance, finances and standard of living, vehicles, a spacecraft, background and campaign notes.
